svg.text: E · native product and private operator tools
Product records enforce effects independently of ACED. The two traffic paths have different access boundaries.
source of experiment and operation records
Private operator subsystem starts at Simulator / BrowserTraffic / strategy; it is not imported by the product or scheduled by core. Simulator owns private SQLite in addition to the product DB;
BrowserState has a separate private checkpoint DB. The operator CLI selects traffic tools; export.export_product() copies only the public allowlist for host workspace preparation.
CURRENT CODE · 2026-10-21 · fields/methods abbreviated · arrows explained in docs/code-structure.md
